comment: (B) KRENKO'S TAP AT ITS QUEUE POSITION. T3, a non-sick Krenko, Mob Boss and one Mountain, hand Goblin Guide; the human queues 'tap Krenko, then cast Goblin Guide'. Before: TapForTokens ran after EVERY cast (so X counted the Guide) even though the viewer queues `act=Krenko` in click order. Now the tap is a step of the "**" sequence: Krenko taps first (X = 1, Krenko alone), then the Guide is cast.
